question: What total group is indicated with respect to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: All earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs are named.
A group called all-field-group is indicated.
The relation is one of possession/genitive to that group.
inference: The all-field-group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The internal structure of that group is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The all-field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
